Jx.bar_b_note: The heavy brown bear-badger has grounded naturalistic fur and good scale, but the noisy yellow speckle plating and dark low-contrast mass fall short of Palworld's clean, saturated creature read, and the neutral stage carries no Valheim-class light.

Le.bar_b_note: The fleece-and-horn ram matches the owner's style bar and reads at Palworld finish; the faint poses (A legs twisted in the air, B horns stretched into flat tubes) are what keep it off the top.

Qd.bar_b_note: Neither boar reaches the bar: A's fur is covered in flat gold coin blobs and its faint-mid body hangs above a detached shadow, while B is a smooth clay toy with moss stickers, off the naturalistic style, and both stand barely trainer height.

Cj.bar_b_note: B's blue-grey translucent panel with full wrapped recipes and large ingredient lines is close to a shipping UI, but the Craft/Leave hints are still small white text with tiny key glyphs and no teal emphasis, and the murky rainy night behind it has no Valheim-class atmosphere.

Hs.bar_b_note: The white-haired elder in a mossy green vest has an expressive, appealing face and a clear silhouette with an earthy palette that belongs to the key art's settlement, at Palworld-class finish.

Hf.bar_b_note: Same bear-badger as Jx: solid scale and grounded anatomy, but the speckled yellow plating reads as noise and the dark body lacks the rim-lit value separation of Palworld creatures.

Wp.bar_b_note: The gold-and-moss lizard has a strong saturated silhouette with a frilled crest that would hold up in Palworld company, but in B the whole body leaves the ground in the hit react, and on a bare stage nothing shows Valheim-class light.

Rw.bar_b_note: B's lifted mauve-violet fur finally shows the quilled mole-hedgehog's form, but the coat still lacks markings or rim light and A is a near-black lump, short of Palworld's high-contrast creatures.

top_changes.change: Ground and clean up the hurt/faint states across the roster: snuff the aspect flame on faint (Jx A, Hf B), keep feet planted in hit reacts (Wp B), stop the floating faint-mid on the boar (Qd A), and fix the twisted faint legs and horn stretching on the ram (Le A/B).
Lift dark creature albedo and add rim light and readable markings (Rw, Jx/Hf body), and replace noisy yellow speckle/coin-blob patterns with authored markings so silhouettes separate at 30%.

Rebuild the boar (Qd) to the owner's naturalistic style bar, with real bristled fur, moss accents per the Mudsnout board, and a height clearly above the 1.80 m trainer, replacing both the coin-blob and the clay-toy versions.
